environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has no custom response header rules configured. The application does not set any Content-Security-Policy headers. Thymeleaf 3.1 is used for server-side rendering. The application is accessed directly via the ALB DNS endpoint over HTTPS with default security headers only (X-Amzn-Trace-Id, etc.).

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB with default config
config.response_headers: No CSP header, no X-Content-Type-Options, default Spring Security disabled
config.network: Public ALB endpoint, no WAF attached
